notes: Scripted hits for the fake collectors behind gwylio collect --dry-run, gwylio probe and the collection tests. Each hit names a query in config/instrument.json and says in its note what the gates should do with it. With the default disciplines (osint_web, osint_site, osint_feed) the funnel is: raw 30, dropped own 2, dropped negative 5, dropped unrelated 3, passed 20, unique 17. The two osint_academic hits join only when that discipline runs.
